snippet.title: OFFICIAL TRAILER  - Absolute Tennis Manager 2
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of tennis with ATM 2! Create or take on the role of a player and manage every aspect of their career: schedule, training, staff, personal life...
Build your legend, tournament after tournament, and aim for the ultimate place in the Hall of Fame.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Available in 9 languages : English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Chinese, Japanese and Russian

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

On Steam on February 13, 2026
